title: HyperOS 4 on Xiaomi Pad 5 3-Click Install, No PC + Full Tour
blurb: HyperOS 4 ported to the Xiaomi Pad 5, and you can put it on without a PC, without Termux and without typing one command.
video_description:
HyperOS 4 ported to the Xiaomi Pad 5, and you can put it on without a PC, without Termux and without typing one command. Three taps in the tool, a format confirmation, and the tablet boots into a new UI. Then we take the full tour: Liquid Glass, animations, themes, Control Center, all of it.

🛠️ What You Need
• Xiaomi Pad 5
• The HyperOS 4 port for the Pad 5, either as a package or an extracted folder in storage
• The Rom Flasher Tool installed on the tablet
• A backup of anything you care about, because the flash formats the data partition

📝 Steps
1. Connect the tablet and open the tool. It picks up the device.
2. Reboot into fastboot and confirm on screen.
3. Go to the Flash section and select either the ROM file or the extracted folder.
4. Choose the Windows-style flash path when it asks, since the tool is built around that flow.
5. Confirm the format prompt, then let the flash run to the end.
6. First boot takes a few minutes. Set up, and you're in HyperOS 4.

🧊 What You Get
• Liquid Glass design across the system
• New animations, themes and Control Center layout
• Pre-rooted with KernelSU 1.0.5.80 Legacy, so root is already in place
• Stock HyperOS package installer swapped for InstallerX Revived
• MSA, AnalyticsCore and MiuiTrustService removed, Gboard added
• Memory Extension off by default, and turning Advanced Textures off makes things smoother

⚠️ Current Issues (straight from the port's own notes)
• Xiaomi Pen and the keyboard don't work yet
• Screen casting is broken
• Some occasional lag can show up
